findings.quote: The help is nonessential, and no basis for principal responsibility is shown. The role is accomplice.
findings.problem: Example 5 expressly establishes agreement and participation in a conspiracy. Under the Revised Penal Code distinction between principals and accomplices, conspiracy can make a participant a principal even when that person’s individual help is not essential. The solution treats essential help as the only remaining basis for principal responsibility. This legal classification needs correction or authoritative support for this particular Section 11(c) interpretation.
